reviews.title: Pretty Good
reviews.text: I’m newer to the ap.  I like it for the most part; easy to use and navigate.  I like you can just click when you take the Unimate and Balance.  There’s an educational section with videos: how to start the program (quite a few which is good for beginners), videos from the docs and other important people etc.  Also, a statistical part where you can put your info in like height, weight, age etc and more.  You also can click to add your First and Last meals and can take a picture then the ap scans it while determining and adding up the caloric intake.  This isn’t always correct so I write in the description box as well and it will figure it out .  You can adjust accordingly.  What it doesn’t allow (and maybe I’m missing this) is to add in your snacks in between the meals, if you have any.  I would like to see that.  For example: fruit and cheese etc

reviews.title: Great User-Friendly App
reviews.text:
The Feel Great - Fasting Coach App has been an amazing tool for helping me stay consistent with my health goals. The app is simple to use, easy to navigate, and keeps everything organized in one place. I really like how it helps track progress and provides helpful guidance that keeps me motivated daily.

What stood out to me most is how encouraging and user-friendly the experience feels. It doesn’t feel overwhelming at all. The information is clear, the layout is clean, and it works smoothly without complications. Since using it alongside the Feel Great System, I’ve become more mindful of my habits, energy levels, and overall wellness journey.

Definitely a great app for anyone serious about improving their lifestyle and staying on track with their goals.

reviews.title: Found My Niche
reviews.text: I was looking for something like this but didn’t know exactly how to get there. I’ve never really liked dinner and my attitude about food is eating to live and not living to eat. I found this product on a TikTok live, understood the concept immediately and purchased right away after the scientific explanation. I’ve been on it so far for two weeks. I am extremely satisfied. It’s amazing how my mind knows I’m supposed to eat, but the drink staves off the hunger and allows me to drink plenty of water. Because I already drink Kangen water (alkaline), I’m never bloated. I have energy and started walking again daily to do something with my energy. The Yerba Mate is subtle which I already knew that and how it positively affects the body. I’ve lost weight already and my blood pressure is excellent. I’m into fitness and a healthy lifestyle so there wasn’t that much work to do. However, this product has taken my healthy lifestyle to the next level. I’m considering doing this long term. I totally agree with all the TikTok videos I’ve seen about this product. It really is awesome.
